readings.reading: Level 50 card. Talent at four of five upgrade diamonds: 'Grants +27% Skill Intensity and Weapon Damage when there are enemies within 20 meters' (database card at 0/5: +15%), four steps of +20% of the base (15 x 1.8 = 27). Main stat Firepower +36.00% (database level 1: +18.00%); Firepower +358, All Weapon Damage +286, Health +9,402 (level 1: +77, +62, +2,043).
